short: Chowla–Selberg for the mean of the logarithmic eta terms

lean.name: GlobalTheory.chowla_selberg_eta
lean.plain: Chowla–Selberg for the mean of the logarithmic eta terms
lean.note: The Chowla–Selberg identity takes the mean of $\log(4\pi\,\operatorname{Im}\tau\,|\eta(\tau)|^4)$ over imaginary quadratic ideal classes. Its value includes $-L'(1,\chi_d)/L(1,\chi_d)$, the quadratic $L$-function term in the period calculation.
